review_type: Independent static and saved-data arithmetic review; no optimizer/simulation/test suite
scope_limitations: No returned stage-1 candidates or planning covariance exist in source traces; these remain offline surrogate diagnostics.
Independent probability arithmetic covers pilot DoN .85 seed 1 from each controller, not all trial traces.
Geometry is archived implementation; this review checks covariance/probability arithmetic, not physical model calibration.
CPU float32 sensitivity is not bitwise reproduction of archived CUDA float32 execution.

static_findings.alignment: xi1[k] resets Sigma0 and propagates applied_inputs[k], then evaluates poses[k+1]; no cumulative run-wide covariance.
static_findings.eligibility: Successful solver-called steps supply both numerator and denominator, fallback excluded, first successful step retained.
static_findings.cohort: Common-success seeds at each width, with matching initial poses independently audited.
static_findings.mf_rows: Evaluable probability_sum includes domain-inactive rows, with no slack and no required-row eligibility filter.
static_findings.switch_comparison: Both formulations use identical pose pairs and fixed body covariance, reported separately by source trajectory.
static_findings.aggregation: Pooled counts and mean trial rates are separate; boundary-jump averages are event-weighted.
static_findings.switch_sampling: Only endpoint-ID-changing intervals inspected; nine-point grid/bisection does not guarantee every continuous crossing.
static_findings.probability: MF R is an untruncated probability sum/union bound and can exceed 1, not an empirical collision probability.

verdict: passes reviewed static alignment and independent pilot arithmetic; native stage-1 metric remains unavailable
